relations.subject: Dirk van Hinloopen Labberton
relations.evidence: In 1904-13 taught Javanese, later also Malay, at Willem III Gymnasium in Batavia (Jakarta)

relations.subject: Dirk van Hinloopen Labberton
relations.evidence: In 1914-16 he taught Malay at Bestuursschool in Batavia.

relations.subject: Dirk van Hinloopen Labberton
relations.role: teacher of Dutch, Malay, Javanese and Sanskrit
relations.evidence: In 1923-25 taught Dutch, but also Malay, Javanese and Sanskrit, at Imperial University in Tokyo.

relations.subject: Dirk van Hinloopen Labberton
relations.evidence: In 1927 he was among the founders of “Theosofisch Lyceum” in Naarden

relations.subject: Dirk van Hinloopen Labberton
relations.evidence: worked as its teacher and Rector until 1937
